comment: Semantic parity manifest for the NixOS omarchy skill. Every h2-h4 (##+) heading and every Command Groups table row in the upstream default/omarchy-skill/SKILL.md must appear here, classified as preserved (carried over verbatim in intent), adapted (rewritten for NixOS), or omitted (intentionally excluded, reason required). checks.omarchy-skill fails when upstream adds a section or command group that is not classified here, or when this manifest classifies something upstream removed. An optional 'anchor' string is grepped in our SKILL.md to prove the classified content is actually present.

When This Skill MUST Be Used.note: Trigger list lives in the frontmatter description (what agents actually match on) plus the intro; paths rewritten to the NixOS port. A redundant MUST section duplicates the frontmatter and drifts.

Critical Safety Rules.note: 'Ownership and Safety': $OMARCHY_PATH replaces /usr/share/omarchy as the never-edit tree (on NixOS it is literally read-only); the pkexec remark moved to the dedicated Privilege Escalation section.

Privilege Escalation.note: Same policy (sudo in a visible terminal, pkexec only for non-interactive callers) with NixOS specifics: sudo via /run/wrappers, omarchy scripts already handle their own elevation.

System Architecture.note: Component table kept, base-OS row describes NixOS + the consumer flake instead of Arch /etc ownership.

Command Discovery.note: Same discovery commands; adds the runtime-manifest quarantine warning (some discovered commands are declarative-note stubs, not working install paths) and the NixOS package commands.

Command Groups.note: Group table kept; launch added; install/pkg/setup rows describe the NixOS replacement or the stub behavior instead of the Arch flow.

Configuration Locations.note: Hyprland/shell/terminals carried over; adds the Other Configs table (btop, fastfetch, lazygit, starship, git) with the NixOS caveat that no system fastfetch default is installed.

Hyprland (Window Manager).note: Same file map and the reload/configerrors validation loop; reset path is omarchy refresh hyprland.

Omarchy shell (Status Bar + Notification.note: Single-Quickshell architecture, shell.json hot-reload, plugin clone workflow — all platform-independent; paths kept.

Terminals.note: Same four terminal config paths and omarchy restart terminal.

Other Configs.note: Table kept (btop, fastfetch, lazygit, starship, git); no /etc/fastfetch system default is installed on NixOS so only the user file is documented; git identity notes the omarchy.full_name/email_address source.

Safe Customization Patterns.note: The four patterns are folded into 'Common Workflows' (backup, narrowest reset with confirmation, hooks, new-theme flow).

Pattern 1: Edit User Config Directly.note: Same read-backup-edit-apply loop; the apply step lists the NixOS-relevant reload/restart commands per component.

Pattern 2: Make a new theme.note: Custom theme under ~/.config/omarchy/themes copied from $OMARCHY_PATH/themes stock; never edit the store copy.

Pattern 3: Use Hooks for Automation.note: Same .d hook directories and omarchy hook install; pre-refresh-pacman.d noted as never firing on NixOS.

Pattern 4: Reset to Defaults -- ALWAYS S.note: Same confirmation-first rule; narrowest reset via omarchy refresh; the upstream nuclear option (omarchy reinstall) only chains stubs on NixOS and the re-seed workflow replaces it.

Common Tasks.note: Themes/keybindings/monitors/window-rules carried over; adds the Fonts and System tasks upstream lists; system power commands marked user-safe.

Themes.note: theme list/current/set/bg next are platform-independent and kept; theme install <git-url> documented (writes under ~/.config/omarchy/themes, user-safe); adds the custom-theme-from-stock workflow and the never-edit-the-store-copy rule.

Keybindings.note: Same o.bind/hl.unbind workflow including the rebind notification rule.

Display/Monitors.note: Same hl.monitor({}) editing plus hyprctl monitors all.

Window Rules.note: Same warning about syntax churn and the o.window() helper; doc check pointed at the installed Hyprland version rather than a blind wiki fetch.

Fonts.note: omarchy font list/current/set are user-safe on NixOS (write user config, fire the font-set hook).

System.note: update/version/debug kept; lock/shutdown/reboot documented as user-safe wrappers with the agent-session caution.

Troubleshooting.note: debug/refresh guidance kept; upstream's 'omarchy reinstall' nuclear option only chains stubs on NixOS and is replaced by the re-seed workflow.

Decision Framework.note: Same decision order; the package branch points at omarchy-nix-* instead of omarchy pkg/pkg aur.

Reminder Requests.note: Reminder flow is platform-independent; kept as-is.

Out of Scope.note: Explicit section kept; scope boundary is the omarchy-nix / upstream source trees (repository AGENTS.md), not omarchy dev link.

Example Requests.note: Example set kept where NixOS-safe; package examples rewritten to the omarchy-nix workflow.

refresh.note: omarchy-refresh-* are user-safe (store-to-$HOME copies patched with --no-preserve=mode).

hook.note: Hook install writes under ~/.config/omarchy/hooks; pre-refresh-pacman.d exists but never fires on NixOS.

install.note: The menu/catalog path is NixOS-native (omarchy-nix-add). Direct omarchy-install-* calls are declarative-note stubs or nixos-adapted; webapp/TUI install stays upstream user-level.

launch.note: omarchy-launch-* are user-safe launchers (browser, terminal, editor, webapp, tui).

pkg.reason: pacman/AUR interface; omarchy-pkg-* are declarative-note stubs on NixOS. Replaced by omarchy-nix-search/add/remove writing omarchy-packages.json.

setup.note: Interactive setup wizards that mutate the system (fingerprint, lock, sshd, timezone, plymouth) are declarative-note stubs or hidden menu entries on NixOS — the equivalent is the named NixOS/omarchy option in the consumer flake.

update.note: omarchy update keeps the UX shell; the core resolves the consumer flake (OMARCHY_NIX_FLAKE) and runs nix flake update + nixos-rebuild; transactions are locked/atomic with audit logs.
